name: Zamok v Piskah
source:
Castle in the Sands is a pixel art visual novel set in a world inspired by One Thousand and One Nights and North African culture. The adventure begins in the heart of the desert and leads you to fairytale places full of magic and danger.

You are a young hunter who lives with his family in a little village deep in the desert. One day, your younger brother falls sick, and you go on a trip to find a doctor. At night, you meet a mysterious girl who calls herself Tiziri. Maybe she can help your brother? 

Soon, you find yourself in a big ancient castle located in the middle of the Sahara — a beautiful, but fragile place. Its walls seem to crumble at your touch. And only your decisions can save it from the danger of human ambition and greed. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4463700/Castle_in_the_Sands/]Steam[/url]]
